_comment: v1.1 Sentinel — savestate MD5 golden file.
Each entry is the MD5 of the SFORMAT binary produced by
FCEUSS_SaveMS after loading the corresponding ROM and running
60 emulation frames. Generated from a v1.0+471d5b3 build on
Windows Server 2022 (GitHub Actions runner, x64, MSVC 14.44).
The hash is platform-independent (SFORMAT is integer-only), so
the same values should match on any x64 host.
If a future code change alters the savestate binary format
(e.g. adding/removing SFORMAT entries in v1.9 Chronicle's
and review the diff in source control before committing.
